level_trim.cap_reason: At its SPEAR target (+0.0 dB vs BOW, trim +6.03 dB) one velocity-1.0 hit would peak at 0.79 (99th percentile of 1024 hits) before the Volume knob, above the 0.25 limit; capped to the largest trim that keeps that peak at 0.25.

notes: Not a V19 preset: the strike model of docs/hihat_reference.py (Kris, 2026-11-20), interpolated per strike by FastEngine.
T60 of each mode: ln(1000) / the fully open knot's decay rate of its band; exc_norm: the fully open knot's mode weights. Position weights 1, no drift.
